name: Thought Line
description: A "thinking" bar that announces its steps one by one and finally settles and calms down.
interactionNotes: The line reveals the steps one by one, with a soft shimmer sliding over the current text. When it finishes, a thin colored line advances, the text fades slightly, and it takes on the done color. If collapsing is enabled, a click collapses and expands it.

props.name: label
props.description: The text shown while it is working.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: The text shown after it finishes; empty means the last step stays.

props.name: renderLabel
props.description: A full replacement for rendering the label.

props.name: glyph
props.description: The marker next to the text.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps shown in order.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Collapse and expand on click.

props.name: collapseOnSettle
props.description: Collapse by itself after finishing.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color.

props.name: glyphColor
props.description: Color of the marker; empty means the same as the text color.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Font size.

props.name: breathPeriod
props.description: Breathing period of the marker, in seconds.

props.name: breathDepth
props.description: Intensity of the breathing.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: A sliding shimmer over the current text.

props.name: shimmerDuration
props.description: Duration of one shimmer cycle, in seconds.

props.name: settleDuration
props.description: Duration of the final settle, in milliseconds.

props.name: settleBlur
props.description: Transient blur while settling.

props.name: working
props.description: Is it still working?

props.name: settleAfter
props.description: Finish by itself after how many seconds; zero means manual.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Elapsed time; omit it to have it count on its own.

props.name: showTimer
props.description: Show the elapsed time.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: When it settles, with the total duration.

tips: Add steps to the list **one at a time**, not all at once. The component checks off each step except the last, so the "one-by-one checking" is only visible when the list also fills up one by one.
When the last step arrives, turn `working` off — that is the moment the last step gets its check, the header settles on "Thought for:", and (if `collapseOnSettle` is on) the list collapses.
Great for a chat assistant: fill the steps from real work so the user knows where they are.
If you give a timeout, it ends by itself after that — good for short, simulated tasks.
Turn the marker off if you already have a marker elsewhere and do not want two.
Do not take `breathDepth` above 0.6: the text's opacity goes from 1 to `1 - depth`, and above that the line effectively disappears.
If you build your own counter and rely on `tabular-nums`: it does not work on **Persian** digits. Peyda has matching glyphs for them. Put each digit in a fixed-width step.
